name: code-review-walkthrough
description: Walk through code changes with related code and tests together, saved review progress, and a local web UI.

interface.shortDescription: A guided review of your code changes.
interface.longDescription: Create a review plan from inferred call relationships, walk the changes in a local browser, and export line-anchored comments. Requires local Node 22.13 or newer, npm, and Git. Experimental alpha.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use code-review-walkthrough to review my current changes against main.
